messages:
Ivy CSM: Need a single-page "clarity card" for customer kickoffs that AEs can paste. Must be tight: prefill, adaptive batching, streaming fallback, short health checks, and renewal indicators.
Marco SE: Keep it friendly for AEs and exact for ops. Give concrete knobs and a tiny example in a different language (Ruby) so it's distinct.
June DevEx: I'll add a short Ruby prefill and a Prometheus alert rule. Also include a one-line customer expectation that sets warm window and p95.
Pat PM: Add a brief "CS action steps" list so we all follow the same escalation flow.
Ivy CSM: Draft customer sentence (paste): "Well prefill your highest-volume intents to reduce cold tails; typical warm window ~10 minutes during initial ramp and p95 should meet your SLOs."
Marco SE: Ops knobs (copy): prefill_ttl=900s (use 1800s for long-session apps), warm_pool=true for steady traffic (>150rps), burst_pool_ttl=300s, batch_target_tokens=768-2048 depending on latency/throughput tradeoffs.
June DevEx: Ruby prefill snippet (copy):
```ruby
require 'net/http'
uri = URI('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill')
req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
req['Authorization'] = "Bearer "+ENV['REDWOOD_KEY']
req['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
req.body = { model: 'rwd-chat-1', intents: ['search','submit'], ttl: 900 }.to_json
res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port, use_ssl: true) { |http| http.request(req) }
puts res.body
```
June DevEx: Prometheus alert (copy):
```yaml
- alert: WarmWindowDegraded
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) > 1
  for: 1h
```
Ivy CSM: CS action steps when a signal fires (copy):
1) Open triage with SE within 4h.
2) Enable burst pool + prefill top-20 intents (24h).
3) Lower batch_target_tokens to 512 if tail latency persists (48h).
4) Offer quantized routing with QA gate if cost becomes a primary concern (72h).
Pat PM: Renewal indicators (copy): sustained p95 > 1s for 24h, cache hit < 35% for 48h, streaming errors > 10% for 3 days, WoW cost increase > 25% — trigger AE outreach and CS/SE warroom.
HookBot: Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/onboarding/clarity-card-compact
Ivy CSM: Perfect. I'll paste this into the kickoff doc and link the Confluence card. Thanks all :v:
